name: The Watch Berth
description: The bell wakes you: three strokes, the last watch. The Erebus is coming round Gordian Moon for the final time with her core banked and nobody else aboard to take the bridge. {hint}(go bridge){/}

name: The Bridge
description: Five consoles in a half ring, most of them dark. The watch's {key}orders{/} hang over the middle one as a wheel of lights: what is done, what can be done, what waits. {hint}(orders){/}

on_first_enter.say: The orders are short. Wake the core. Mark a place to land. Get the lander out, across the drift, and down.

on_sim_done.say: The core holds at power. Console by console, the bridge comes alight.

on_sim_fail.say: The core scrams itself. It will take a while to coax back.

on_sim_done.say: The beacon stands by the old mast, unfolded, its lamp turning. There is a place to come down.

on_sim_fail.say: The pass is over before the beacon is away. The moon will come round again.

on_sim_done.say: The lander hangs clear of the doors on its arm, and the arm lets go.

on_sim_fail.say: The doors jam half way. The motors need a while to cool.

name: Lander: approach
description: The lander's helm, slaved to this console.

on_sim_done.say: The lander sits in the drop ring, the moon filling everything below it.

on_sim_fail.say: The console goes dark, and comes back with the lander where it started.

on_sim_done.say: Dust blows out flat from under the lander and settles.

on_sim_fail.say: The console goes dark, and comes back with the lander at the ring.
